title: 第13章 青帝赏赐不是他陆尘凭什么啊第14章 我一个小小的皇子要杀手组织干什么嘛
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
“十一殿下到！”
金銮殿之中的气氛有些焦灼。
大概几分钟后，金銮殿外面，传来一道悠长的公鸭子嗓。
听到这道公鸭子嗓，金銮殿中的众多文武大臣先是一愣，再是面面相觑。
十一殿下是谁？
哦，好像是陛下一个不起眼的儿子，
不过。这个时候，十一殿下怎么到了？
众多文武大臣有些迷茫了。
而青帝听到这话，脸上却是露出了一丝笑容。
而这个时候，只见金銮殿大门中，一个稚嫩的身影走入金銮殿中，
身着紫金色蟒龙袍，和陆尘稚嫩的脸庞搭起来有些突兀。
在众大臣的注视下，陆尘丝毫不慌的走入金銮殿之中，笑呵呵的向青帝拱手。
“儿臣见过父皇！”
“哈哈哈。小十一到了。这么大早起来，吃完饭了嘛？”
看到陆尘，青帝再也掩饰不住欣喜的神色。哈哈大笑，随后开口说道。
而金銮殿两侧，众多文武大臣看到青帝面对陆尘，脸上竟然如此欣喜，最重要的是。
青帝什么时候这么随和了？
上来还问问有没有吃早饭。
要知道，青帝面对任何皇子，都没有如此随和关心过啊。
而在金銮殿斜前方，正静静站着一个身着明黄色蟒龙袍，大概三十岁左右，身上散发着柔和气息的男子。

此人正是大乾大皇子，陆凌！
今年将近三十岁，已经是皇境强者。
文武兼备，备受朝野推崇，民间更是有些不小的威望。
而且，陆凌是众多皇子中，唯一一个被青帝允许，每天参加朝会的皇子。
因此，虽然说青帝还没有立太子。
但是在满朝文武眼中，大皇子陆凌和太子已经差不多了。
只不过，此刻，陆凌看到眼前这个自己从来没见过几次面，而且自己已经快要遗忘的弟弟。陆凌却是愣了一下。
仔细思考了一会，才想起来是谁。
看到陆尘进入金銮殿，陆凌有些懵逼。
小十一？
咋滴，小十一就是父皇要等的人嘛？
再看向满脸笑容的青帝。
哪怕是满朝文武和陆凌再不敢置信，但是也不得不承认。
刚才青帝说的等人，好像等的就是十一皇子，
“父皇，儿臣还没来得及吃饭呢！”
陆尘听到此言，笑呵呵的开口。
“没有吃饭啊，那等到退朝的时候，和朕一起吃。”
听到陆尘稚嫩的声音，青帝笑呵呵的开口。
“多谢父皇。”
陆尘听到此言眼睛一亮连连点头。

正好趁着这个机会问问青帝，有没有什么需要自己帮忙的，赶紧把逆袭任务给完成了。
听着这父子俩如此亲近的对话，满朝文武尽皆恍惚。
大皇子陆凌听到此言却是有些心酸。
父皇啊父皇，
你给小十一的爱，儿子从来没有享受过啊。
content_en:
"His Royal Highness Eleven is here!"
The atmosphere in the Jinluan Palace was a little anxious.
About a few minutes later, a long male duck's voice came from outside the Jinluan Palace.
Upon hearing this male duck's voice, many civil and military ministers in the Jinluan Palace were first stunned, and then looked at each other.
Who is His Highness Eleven?
Oh, he seems to be an inconspicuous son of His Majesty,
However. Why is His Highness Eleven here at this time?
Many civil and military ministers were a little confused.
When Qingdi heard this, a smile appeared on his face.
At this time, I saw a young figure walking into the gate of Jinluan Palace.
Wearing a purple-gold python dragon robe, it looked a little awkward with Lu Chen's childish face.
Under the gaze of all the ministers, Lu Chen walked into the Jinluan Palace without any panic, and smiled and handed over to the Qing Emperor.
"My son has met my father!"
"Hahaha. Little Eleven is here. You're up so early. Have you finished your meal?"
Seeing Lu Chen, Qingdi could no longer hide his joy. He laughed and then spoke.
On both sides of the Jinluan Hall, many civil and military ministers had such joy on their faces when they saw Qing Emperor facing Lu Chen. The most important thing was.
When did Emperor Qing become so easy-going?
I came up and asked if I had breakfast.
You know, Emperor Qing has never been so easy-going and caring towards any prince.
And diagonally in front of the Jinluan Hall, stood quietly a man in a bright yellow python dragon robe, about thirty years old, exuding a soft aura.
This person is none other than the eldest prince of Daqian, Lu Ling!
He is nearly thirty years old this year and is already a strong man in the imperial realm.
He is both civil and military, highly respected by both the government and the public, and has considerable prestige among the people.
Moreover, Lu Ling was the only prince among the many princes who was allowed by the Qing Emperor to attend court meetings every day.
Therefore, although Emperor Qing has not established a prince yet.
But in the eyes of the civil and military officials of the Manchu Dynasty, the eldest prince Lu Ling was almost the same as the prince.
However, at this moment, Lu Ling saw in front of him this younger brother whom he had never seen before and whom he had almost forgotten. Lu Ling was stunned for a moment.
After thinking carefully for a while, I remembered who it was.
Seeing Lu Chen enter the Jinluan Palace, Lu Ling was a little confused.
Little Eleven?
Hey, is Little Eleven the one the father wants to wait for?
Then he looked at Qingdi with a smile on his face.
Even if Man Chao Wenwu and Lu Ling couldn't believe it, they had to admit it.
The person Qingdi mentioned just now seems to be waiting for the eleventh prince.
"Father, I haven't had time to eat yet!"
When Lu Chen heard this, he said with a smile.
"You haven't eaten yet. Then wait until you retire and eat with me."
Hearing Lu Chen's childish voice, Qingdi spoke with a smile.
"Thank you, Father."
Lu Chen's eyes lit up when he heard this and nodded repeatedly.
I just took this opportunity to ask Qingdi if there was anything he needed help with, and quickly completed the counterattack mission.
Listening to the close conversation between father and son, everyone in the court was in a daze.
The eldest prince Lu Ling felt a little sad when he heard this.
Father, oh father,
My son has never enjoyed the love you gave Xiao Shiyi.
